title: REER-PT: Reverse-Engineered Reasoning for Perplexity-Guided Pre-training Data Augmentation
abstract: arXiv:2608.30627v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As language-model compute continues to scale, high-quality training data is becoming an increasingly important bottleneck. Conventional next-token prediction supervises what follows a context but leaves the intermediate reasoning behind that continuation implicit. We introduce \textbf{REER-PT}, a scalable framework that extends Reverse-Engineered Reasoning (REER) to raw pre-training data. REER-PT identifies continuations that are difficult to predict but can still be inferred from the preceding context, and inserts concise reasoning annotations that reconstruct the missing connection between context and continuation. Candidate annotations are generated and refined offline, with perplexity serving as the optimization signal. Constraints on length and target leakage filter out unhelpful or trivial annotations. translated_title: REER-PT：面向困惑度引导的预训练数据增强的逆向工程推理
translated_abstract: 随着语言模型计算规模的不断扩大，高质量训练数据正成为日益重要的瓶颈。传统的下一个词预测只监督上下文之后的内容，却将生成该后续内容背后的中间推理过程隐含起来。我们提出了REER-PT，这是一个可扩展的框架，将逆向工程推理扩展到原始预训练数据上。REER-PT识别出那些难以预测但仍可从先前上下文推断出的后续内容，并插入简洁的推理标注，以重建上下文与后续内容之间缺失的联系。候选标注在离线状态下生成和优化，并以困惑度作为优化信号。通过长度和目标泄露方面的约束，过滤掉无用或平凡的标注。这种稀疏变换保留了源文本，并与标准的下一个词预测保持兼容，避免了在线重（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: REER-PT提出了一种可扩展的预训练数据增强框架，利用困惑度作为优化信号，离线识别难以预测但可从上下文推断的文本片段，并插入逆向工程生成的简洁推理标注，在保留源文本、兼容标准下一词预测的前提下，显式补全上下文与后续内容之间缺失的推理联系。
en_tdlr: REER-PT is a scalable pre-training data augmentation framework that uses perplexity as an optimization signal to identify hard-yet-inferable continuations and offline inserts concise reverse-engineered reasoning annotations, explicitly bridging the missing connection between context and continuation while preserving the source text and remaining compatible with standard next-token prediction.
